message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: employee (security guard) stole chips from company, value 359,076 RMB, sold for 59,000. That's theft (盗窃). The prosecution says theft. No other crimes like fraud, etc. So answer: 盗窃.

Check if any other crimes like "职务侵占"? He used his position to steal, but theft is appropriate. In Chinese law, theft by employee is still theft, not embezzlement (职务侵占) because he didn't have authority to take property; he physically took it. So answer: 盗窃.

Thus output: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
